products.title: Buggy to Cybercab Prints
products.body_html:
“Buggy to Cybercab” captures the moment one era of transportation gives way to another. A family trades literal horsepower for electric power, stepping out of a horse-drawn carriage and into a futuristic autonomous vehicle. Centuries of innovation are separated by a single open door; one ride comes with one horse and a driver, while the other comes with hundreds of horsepower and no driver at all. The technology has changed beyond recognition, but the purpose remains the same: getting people from where they are to where they want to go.

Only 100 are printed & signed. 120 lb cardstock

products.title: MJ Hurricane Winds  Prints
products.body_html:
“MJ Hurricane Winds” captures the world’s greatest entertainer standing against an impossible force. His hair, clothing, and jacket are violently swept backward, yet his feet remain planted as he leans directly into the storm. Clutching his hat to his chest, he appears graceful even in chaos. The hurricane represents more than wind; it symbolizes the pressure, fame, scrutiny, and adversity that surrounded him. Everything is being blown away, but the man himself refuses to move.

Only 100 are printed & signed. 120 lb cardstock

products.title: Area 4-1 Signed  Prints
products.body_html:
A blue-collar floor general forged in the streets of New York faces an alien talent equipped with otherworldly size and abilities. One was seemingly built in a laboratory; the other was built through hard work, toughness, and relentless determination. “AREA 4–1” tells the story of grit defeating genetics—and the city’s hometown hero completing a gentleman’s sweep: graciously surrendering one game before sweeping the extraterrestrial threat back into the pavement.

 

personal note- I saw the OG tip at a watch party on Stone Street. After 53 years of waiting, this night made our championship hopes really real. It was "Knicks in 5" & absolute pandemonium. Only thing I could compare it to would be my experience on Bourbon Street when the Saints won the Super Bowl. Very similar vibe, New York on a much bigger scale.  

Only 100 are printed & signed. 120 lb cardstock

products.title: Niagra Falls Spa Signed  Prints
products.body_html:
“Niagra Falls Spa” transforms one of the world’s greatest natural wonders into one giant hydrotherapy session. After PJ and Jillian experienced the Niagra Falls boat tour together, PJ was inspired to turn the overwhelming mist, force, and chaos of the falls into something playfully relaxing. Lounging beneath the crashing water is a colossal PJ; the giant’s face is the artist’s own self-portrait. Equal parts travel poster, hippy era, mythological fantasy, and New York humor, the piece bridges New York and Ontario with one invitation: Come for the mist, stay for the schvitz.

Only 100 are printed & signed. 120 lb cardstock
